description: Binding-vow definitions that group a difficulty tier and an ordered pair of BindingVowsEffect rows into one selectable vow.

Id.technical: FName row key in BindingVowsDataTable; export label ID. UGameBindingVowsWidget::SetBindingVows and UGameVsEnemyBindingVowsSelectWidget::OnVowFocused scan BindingVowsDataTables with FindRow<FGameDataTableRow_BindingVows>(VowId); GameBindingVows_GetEffectRows resolves the same key from an active/setup vow ID list. None is treated as no vow by the widget callers.

Difficulty.simple: Vow difficulty tier shown on the vow icon.
Difficulty.technical: EGameBindingVowsDifficulty (None=0, Low=1, Middle=2, High=3, Invalid=255). that value maps to EGameWidgetBindingVowsDifficultType (Low->Easy, Middle->Medium, High->Hard, None/Invalid->Special), selects the material's DifficultTypeMaskTexture/FrameTexture, and makes LevelMaxEffect visible only for Special (value 4). Default is None.

Id_BindingVowsEffect.simple: Ordered IDs of the two effect rows belonging to the vow: debuff first, buff second.
Id_BindingVowsEffect.technical: TArray<FName>. GameBindingVows_GetEffectRows iterates every non-None ID, resolves the first matching BindingVowsEffect row in table order and appends it; effect-type queries then filter the resolved rows. The VsEnemy selection UI requires Num() >= 2 and treats [0] as the debuff and [1] as the buff for text; UGameBindingVowsWidget also reads [0] and [1] unchecked for category icons. All exported rows contain exactly two IDs, but the status consumer is length-agnostic.

notes: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves the single retail asset BindingVowsDataTable into BindingVowsDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:290, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:201).

Cross-table join: Id_BindingVowsEffect resolves into BindingVowsEffectDataTables; that in turn carries EffectType, EffectValue and Id_BattleText. PvE lotteries select vow IDs through BindingVowsLotteryDataTable (Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_IntervalPvE.cpp:604-679).

The first/second effect slot convention is explicit in two UI consumers and in every export row, while the generic status helper consumes all listed effects; no evidence of additional slots was found.
Reconstructed static C++ evidence only. The available Content is partial, so direct Blueprint or uncooked consumers cannot be excluded.

usages.detail: SetBindingVows resolves the row to drive icon difficulty frame/mask, debuff/buff category textures and counters.
GameBindingVows_GetEffectRows joins each vow ID to its effect rows for all status/battle-log queries.
GameBindingVows_GetEffectRowsOfType filters the joined effect rows by EGameBindingVowsEffectType.
OnVowFocused resolves the focused vow and formats its two effect rows' battle text.
PvE mission vow selection obtains vow IDs from lotteries and filters candidates through each vow's effect rows.
